attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited submitted a copy of a newspaper advertisement dated November 20, 2026, to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The advertisement was published in Financial Express in English and Vir Arjun in Hindi. The submission is made under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement Regulations 2015. It serves for information and record. The document was signed by Iti Goyal, Assistant Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenues of INR1,211.2 crores for the quarter, marking a 54% year-on-year increase. Gross profit stood at INR233.1 crores, up 20% year-on-year, while EBITDA reached INR125.7 crores with margins at 10.4%. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR99.4 crores. For the first half of FY27, revenues totaled INR2,222.3 crores, showing 44% growth, with profit after tax at INR186 crores. Management highlighted strong industry demand and secured new orders in lightweighting and global businesses, representing a combined lifetime value of $61.5 million. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot seeking shareholder approval for a special resolution. The resolution proposes the appointment of Shri P. Kaniappan, DIN 02696192, as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a term of three consecutive years from November 12, 2026, to November 11, 2029. The cut-off date for determining members entitled to vote is Friday, November 13, 2026. Remote e-voting commences at 9:00 a.m. IST on Friday, November 20, 2026, and ends at 5:00 p.m. IST on Saturday, December 19, 2026. The results, along with the scrutinizer's report, will be declared within the prescribed period and communicated to the stock exchanges.
